verdict.rationale: Kong AI Gateway supports declarative configuration-as-code via kongctl (open YAML/JSON format) and can export operational data (metrics, logs) via OpenTelemetry and audit logs, which gives some data portability, but there is no explicit 'export all my data and leave' capability, bulk data export/deletion tool, or account-level data portability guarantee documented. Missing for 10: an explicit full-data export/account-deletion feature, documentation of exporting all configuration+analytics+logs as a bundle, and any independent confirmation that migration away from Kong is frictionless.
